core.name: Dirge of Destiny
core.text:
Featherbloom on an enemy with any Attribute Anomaly triggers Abloom: an extra round of that Anomaly's DMG, at the rate below per 10 Anomaly Proficiency.
Suspension or Featherbloom on an Anomaly-afflicted enemy inflicts Vivian's Prophecy: Ether DMG of 55% ATK every 0.55s (can trigger Anomaly extra DMG), until the Anomaly ends. Enters battle with 2 Flight Feathers.
